title.$t: Stable Channel Update for ChromeOS / ChromeOS Flex

content.$t:
The Stable channel is being updated to 158.0.8127.140 for most ChromeOS devices.

[N/A][554051967] Critical CVE-2026-134401: Improper input validation in Variations.

The Stable channel has been updated to 158.0.8127.88/.89 for Windows and Mac and 158.0.8127.88 for Linux, which will roll out over the coming days/weeks. A full list of changes in this build is available in the Log.

Security Fixes and Rewards
This update includes 1 security fix. Please see the Chrome Security Page for more information.

[N/A][554051967] Critical CVE-2026-134401: Improper input validation in Variations. Reported by Google on 2026-08-28

We would also like to thank all security researchers that worked with us during the development cycle.

The Extended Stable channel has been updated to 156.0.8078.114 for Windows and Mac.

[N/A][554051967] Critical CVE-2026-134401: Improper input validation in Variations.
The Dev channel has been updated to 160.0.8180.4 for Windows, Mac and Linux.
